commit_message:
Fix vulnerability in RequestManageCredentials

Fix a vulnerability allowing the app developer to hide from the user
what permissions are requested by the app. This is fixed by trimming the
label using loadSafeLabel.

Bug: 473812391
Flag: EXEMPT BUGFIX
Test: Manual - using the APK provided by the security researcher
